goal: Add a tracking flag to autoreload to track changes in manage.py. This should automatically restart the server when manage.py is edited.

tasks.description: Modify the autoreload module to include a tracking flag for manage.py changes.
Update the server management script (e.g., manage.py) to use the new tracking flag.
Implement file change monitoring logic in the autoreload module to detect edits to manage.py and trigger server restart.
Add command-line argument parsing to manage.py to accept the --track-changes flag and pass it to the server.
